# br-web-seo

> Free, open-source Agent Skill that turns Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini, GitHub Copilot or Cursor into an SEO, AEO and GEO auditor: ~220 checks with stable IDs, a 0-100 health score, fix reports, and exports to PDF, Word, Excel and CSV.

## Start here
- [Home and install](https://burhanriaz.github.io/BR-SEO-Skill/): what the skill does, install commands, prompts and sample reports
- [Source code](https://github.com/burhanriaz/BR-SEO-Skill): SKILL.md, references, templates and scripts (MIT)
- [Releases](https://github.com/burhanriaz/BR-SEO-Skill/releases): br-web-seo.zip for Claude.ai, br-web-seo-bundle.md for ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude Projects

## Blog
- [All articles](https://burhanriaz.github.io/BR-SEO-Skill/blog/): guides on technical SEO, AI search, content, structured data, performance, local and international SEO, links and audits
- [RSS feed](https://burhanriaz.github.io/BR-SEO-Skill/blog/feed.xml)
